cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: The model powers an offline advisory console for Sahelian extension officers: retrieval-augmented answers grounded in a packaged agronomy and livestock-health library, with every recommendation citing its source manual. The agronomy knowledge base is integral to the product, not cosmetic.

test_prompts.prompt: I have just harvested my maize and I want to store it for the dry season without weevils eating it. What should I do, and what should I avoid?
My village chickens are dying suddenly in large numbers, healthy birds one day and dead the next. What is the most likely cause and how do I protect the rest of the flock?
